documents.factual_paraphrase: As of June 30, 2026, Meta reports contingent obligations to purchase up to $14.72 billion of cloud capacity over five years, reducible if the cloud service provider sells that capacity to other customers. The provider is unnamed in this passage. The immediately preceding paragraph separately reports $349.31 billion of non-cancelable contractual commitments across multiple categories, with $53.52 billion and $81.65 billion due in 2026 and 2027 respectively. The contingent capacity paragraph begins 'In addition'. For variable-term agreements, Meta does not estimate total obligation beyond minimum quantities and/or pricing as of the reporting date. The passage does not specify annual payments for the contingent arrangement, unilateral cancellation rights, its detailed pricing or delivery schedule, security or claim ranking. It does not identify a guarantee of another borrower's debt.
